abilities.name: Kitchen Skills
_curatorNotes: Normals: 3-hit polearm chain. attackHitmarks = [[7], [16], [27, 40]] — N3 has 2 sub-hits at 27 and 40, last hit gates the cancel window. attackFrames per gcsim attack.go.
N1: ActionAttack default = 17 (animation length per InitNormalCancelSlice(7, 17)); per recipe rule N omitted on N1. Explicit ActionCharge = 20 → C key.
N2: ActionAttack = 29 explicit override (next-normal-into-N3 cancel). Default cancel = 21 → swap.

N3: final hit hitmark = 40, animation length = 62 → swap. ActionCharge = 500 in gcsim is flagged as illegal action; not authored. Per recipe key-set (non-bow final = swap+N only, no C), C is dropped on the final hit. ActionAttack at default → N omitted.
Charge: chargeHitmark = 20 (D/J cancel at the hitmark frame). Standard polearm CA shape. ActionAttack = 53, ActionSkill = 52, ActionBurst = 52, ActionSwap = 52.

Plunges are gated on AirborneXianyun in gcsim — Escoffier can only plunge when launched by Xianyun support. Authored low plunge variant; high plunge has near-identical frames (swap=63, N=60, E=61, Q=60, D=76). ActionDash = 75 explicit; ActionJump = 76 (animation default) → J omitted per convention.

Charged-attack element-application ICD: gcsim charge.go tags it ICDTagExtraAttack / ICDGroupPoleExtraAttack, whose reset timer is 30f (0.5s) with only the first hit of each window applying (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go). Authored as chargedIcdWindow rather than a weapon-type rule in resolveActionIcd: the census is 16 of 19 oracled polearm users, and Xiao, Raiden and Emilie sit on the default. Reachable only while the swing is infused - bare, a polearm charged attack is Physical and applies nothing.

abilities.name: Low-Temperature Cooking
_curatorNotes: Tap (Cold Storage Mode): single instant Cryo hit at frame 23 (skillInital 90.72% ATK at TL10), then spawns the Cooking Mek which follows the active character.

Cooking Mek: 20s lifetime (skillDur). Frosty Parfait ticks at skillFirstTickDelay=148f (2.467s) with skillInterval=58.5f (0.975s) between ticks. Status duration is technically 1318f (≈21.97s = 148 + 20×58.5) but skillDur/summon lifetime caps rendered ticks at 20s. At ~17 ticks fit in the 20s window. skillDot multiplier = 216% ATK Cryo at TL10 (skillDot[9]=2.16).

Surging Blade (Arkhe-Ousia): fires at frame 83 (skillAlignedHitmark) per cast, gated by 10s ICD via skillAlignedICDKey. 60.48% ATK Cryo (arkhe[9]) with ICDTagNone. Not authored — the schema has no per-cast extra-hit primitive that respects a separate ICD pool; would over-render as a constant-on-cast hit if authored as a damage effect with onCast trigger. Flagged in caveat.
Cooldown 15s set with cooldownStartDelay = 22f (gcsim SetCDWithDelay(skill, 15*60, 22)).
particleCB: 4 Cryo particles per cast on enemy hit, 0.2s ICD via particleICDKey. Energy generation is not modelled at the ability level.
summonTick interval and firstTickDelay are recorded in seconds (not frames) to match the schema's existing P3 summonTick conventions; values rounded to 3 decimal places.
[A7] Hold mode (Off-the-Cuff Cookery) has no upstream simulation; only Tap (Cold Storage) is authored. Re-author if a substantive Hold-form kit difference lands upstream.

[A7] Surging Blade Arkhe-Ousia hit (~60% ATK per cast, 10s ICD) pulled from the user caveat: it fires once per cast, the persistent Cooking Mek ticks stand in for its damage flow, and the timeline does not draw damage hits anyway. Detail already in the existing curator notes.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The E bar itself. `hE` tokenizes fine and Escoffier authors no hold variant, so matchVariant falls back to the base ability — a hold cast draws the TAP form's 15s cooldown, its 35f cast and a "Cooking Mek (Cold Storage)" summon lane with 17 Cryo tick marks, none of which is the mode the player asked for. This is also the sanctioned use of the parent-ability caveat channel (N18: variants have no caveat field). Category: visible-divergence.

↻ application[] TRIMMED TO THE CAST'S OWN HIT, 2026-09-16 (T0.5) — it was DOUBLE-FEEDING THE GAUGE. The entries from frame 153 on were the Frosty Parfait ticks (gcsim skillFirstTickDelay 148 + ceil(58.5 × i) + skillTravel 5), and the same stream is authored as the summon's `summonTick` below, so both ran on their own clocks: measured `Escoffier E` at C6 applied at 23, then PAIRS 41 frames apart — 171/212, 348/387, 525/563, 702/738 — where gcsim applies at an even 117f. ⚠️ docs/furina-arkhe-round.md §8 explicitly CLEARED this character on a phase test; the phase was wrong (see the firstTickDelay note), so the test could not see it.

⛔ Frame 83, the Surging Blade, is NOT an application and is gone with the rest: gcsim skill.go:73-84 gives it `Durability: 0`. It carried no `units` either, so it resolved to a provisional 1U — a phantom Cryo pip. ⚠️ This is the `[icd]`-vs-no-durability ambiguity the frames report warns about: the oracle cannot tell a suppressed hit from a zero-durability one.

⚠️ The initial hit and every parfait share ONE counter in gcsim (both are ICDTagElementalArt on ICDGroupEscoffierSkill); here the cast's application[] runs on our standard cast counter and the series on its own `icdGate`, two clocks. That is the corpus-wide per-cast-ICD gap, not something authorable at this site.

↻ firstTickDelay 2.467 → 2.167, 2026-09-16 (T0.5). gcsim's 148f is measured FROM THE CAST and the first parfait lands at 148 + travel 5 = 153f; `collectSummonTicks` starts at spawnAt + firstDelay and `spawnsAt` is 23, so the authored 2.467 (=148f) put every marker 18 frames late — 171/230/289 against gcsim's 153/212/270. The correct value is (148 + 5 − 23) / 60 = 2.167.

↻ icdGate {timer: 90, every: 6} AUTHORED 2026-09-16 (T0.5) — the series is NOT on the standard gate. Every parfait is ICDGroupEscoffierSkill, whose table entry is a 90f window with sequence {1,0,0,0,0,0} (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go:104,170), i.e. every sixth hit applies inside a 1.5s window; ours ran the default 150f / every-3. ⚠️ The ICD-group round missed it for Durin's reason: the frames report's oracle column is EMPTY here, because the dumper files the parfaits under the cast. ↻ 2026-10-04 (ICD cap round): {timer: 90} — FIRST ONLY. gcsim reads past the list's end as its last entry (0), so {1,0,0,0,0,0} never reaches a 6th-hit application; 'every sixth' read it as cyclic. At 59f two hits fit a window, so nothing moves.

⏭ OPEN, a decision not an edit: gcsim runs skillTicks = 21 at 58.5f, i.e. a status of 148 + 20 × 58.5 = 1318f ≈ 21.97s, while the kit's (and our) summon duration is 20s, which yields 19 markers. `tickCap` cannot ADD ticks — it only bounds, widening by at most one interval — so recovering the last two needs the authored `duration` to grow, which would then make the summon bar disagree with the 20s the talent publishes. Left alone.
abilities.description:
Behold the true meaning of "cooking"! Escoffier will demonstrate different cooking techniques when you Tap or Hold this skill, but rest assured, each of them is Fontaine's pride and joy.

Tap
Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Cold Storage mode and deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents.

Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode
Follows the current active character and fires Frosty Parfaits at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing Cryo DMG.

Arkhe: Ousia
At intervals, Escoffier will summon a Surging Blade when activating her Cooking Mek in Cold Storage mode, dealing Ousia-aligned AoE Cryo DMG.

Hold
Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek's Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode.

abilities.name: Scoring Cuts
_curatorNotes: Burst hits at frame 92 (hitmark). Initial heal at frame 97 (initialHeal — gcsim notes 'depends on ping' so small client-side variance).

burstFrames AnimationLength=110, ActionSwap=108, ActionSkill=109. Other actions default to 110 (animation length) → omitted from the FrameMap per recipe convention. Per framemap_conventions, burst FrameMap typically includes { swap, N, E, D, J }; only swap and E diverge from the default here.

Initial heal scaling: burstHealFlat[9] + burstHealPer[9] × ATK = 2372.936 + 309.6576% ATK at TL10. Schema's heal effect carries only the ATK-scaling component; flat-heal (2372.936) is dropped — a known schema gap (no mixed flat+scaling heal value form). The flat component is tier-relevant for low-ATK supports but secondary to the per-ATK contribution.
ConsumeEnergy(5) at end of burst — drains an additional 5 energy beyond the 60 cost (similar to Yanfei). Not modelled.
burstCD = 15s (burstCD[9]). cooldownStartDelay omitted: gcsim SetCD(burst, 15*60) is called immediately at cast, no delay.
Burst element is Cryo (attributes.Cryo); hits are AttackTagElementalBurst with ICDTagNone.

↻ `flat: 2372.936` AUTHORED 2026-09-16 (T0.5). The talent row is "309.7% ATK + 2373" and gcsim computes burstHealFlat[9] + burstHealPer[9] × TotalAtk. The old note called the mixed form "a known schema gap"; `flat?: number` is declared on the heal effect and Bennett and Qiqi both use it, so half this heal had simply been dropped.
abilities.description: Displaying her exceptional knife skills, Escoffier deals AoE Cryo DMG and restores HP to all nearby party members based on her ATK.

passives.name: Better to Salivate Than Medicate
_curatorNotes: Rehab Diet: 9 ticks at firstTick=157f (2.617s post-cast) + interval=58.5f (0.975s). Each tick heals active char for 138.24% ATK (a1Scaling = 1.3824 at TL?? — note: a1Scaling is a constant in asc.go, not talent-scaled).

Authored as a single heal effect with duration 9s — the per-tick cadence isn't expressible in the schema (heal effects don't carry tick interval). The 9s window represents the full Rehab Diet status duration; user reads it as 'active char heals over 9s after Q'.

C4 extends Rehab Diet by 6s (a4Dur: 12 + 6 = 18 ticks total at C4) and adds RNG-based bonus heal + 2 energy regen. Not authored — schema has no duration-extension on passive heal effects, and the C4 RNG bonus is gated on Escoffier's CR which the planner doesn't track.
passives.description: After using the Elemental Burst Scoring Cuts, Escoffier will obtain the Rehab Diet effect for 9s: Restores HP for nearby active characters every 1s based on 138.24% of Escoffier's ATK.

passives.name: Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning
_curatorNotes: A4 callback (makeA4CB) is attached to: skill initial hit, Surging Blade, Frosty Parfait ticks, and burst hit. All four hit paths apply both Cryo and Hydro shred.

Authored as 2 effects (Cryo, Hydro) at the 4-char-count value. 4-char value is the canonical Escoffier team build (e.g. Wriothesley + Citlali + Ayaka + Escoffier). ↻ Its old rider — "the 5/10/15/55% scaling by char count isn't expressible, would require a 'team element count' condition primitive" — is superseded; see the ↻ note below.

Trigger onHit ability=skill captures the dominant rotation (Escoffier E → swap → Q on a separate cycle). ↻ Its old rider — "adding a second pair with ability=burst would render duplicate bars" — is superseded; see the ↻ note below.

[A7] The -55% is authored as a fixed value; the 5/10/15/55 scaling by combined Hydro+Cryo member count is not expressed. ⚠️ This line used to add "teamElementCount / perTeamCount are now wired" — half right, and `perTeamCount` is the wrong half twice over: `resShred.value` is a plain `number`, not a `BuffValue`, so a `perTeamCount` value cannot be authored here at all; and where it CAN be authored the formatter only prints the per-member formula, never value × count (src/lib/timeline/buffDisplay.ts:74-82). `teamElementCount` is the one that works.

↻ 2026-08-18 — THREE DEFERRALS ON THIS PASSIVE ARE NOW UNBLOCKED. All three are authorable today; none is authored, and each is a separate decision, so ⛔ don't land them as one edit. (1) THE 5/10/15/55 LADDER. `teamElementCount` resolves definitively in this exact pool: `baseCtx` carries `teamElementCounts` (buffWindows.ts:360-364) and `resShredBase` evaluates each effect's conditions against it BEFORE `dedupResShredByElement` runs (:367-375, :448-451), so mutually-exclusive tiers are filtered down to the one matching tier and the dedupe then keeps it — this is NOT the tier-ladder trap that eats sibling `buff` effects (there the stat dedupe runs first). ⚠️ The map is HOLDER-EXCLUDED and Escoffier is Cryo, so the four rungs are excl-self counts 0/1/2/3, not 1/2/3/4 — the same excl-self trick Itto's C2 modifiers use. Cost: 8 effects (4 tiers × Cryo/Hydro) instead of 2. (2) SKILL + BURST ON ONE EFFECT. "One effect can't combine Skill+Burst triggers" is false — `Trigger.onHit.abilityType` takes an ARRAY (src/lib/types/ability.ts:510-516), and this character's own C6 already authors `['normal','charged','plunge']`. ⚠️ An array is not free: `getCharacterEffectsForOnHit` is called once per cast class, so `['skill','burst']` qualifies in BOTH pools and emits a 12s window at the E cast and another at the Q cast. (3) THAT IS NO LONGER "duplicate bars". Overlapping same-shape bars on one row refresh-MERGE into a single covered span since 2026-08-15 (src/lib/timeline/mergeRefreshedBars.ts, applied at teamBuffRows.ts:170) — identical stat and identical formatted value is the whole test, which two -55% cryo shreds pass. Non-overlapping casts stay two bars, which is correct rather than noisy. ⚠️ VERIFICATION BOUNDARY: the merge rule and both emit sites were read in source; an E-then-Q rotation was NOT rendered to confirm the two windows land on ONE row key rather than two. Check that before authoring (2).

[A7] Shred is authored only on the Skill-hit trigger. In typical E-then-swap-then-Q rotations the skill precedes the burst within the 12s window, so the shown window timing is practically correct — which is why (2) above is an accuracy improvement, not a bug fix.

↻ DEFERRALS (1) AND (2) FROM THE 2026-08-18 NOTE ARE BOTH LANDED, 2026-09-16 (T0.5). The ladder is 8 effects — four mutually-exclusive `teamElementCount` rungs × Cryo/Hydro. ⚠️ gcsim indexes a4Shred by the Hydro+Cryo count INCLUDING Escoffier (a4Init counts every party member and he is Cryo), and `teamElementCount` is HOLDER-EXCLUDED, so the four rungs are excl-self 0/1/2/3 for gcsim's 1/2/3/4 — the same excl-self trick Itto's C2 modifiers use. ⚓ It works here and would NOT work on a `buff`: `resShredBase` evaluates each effect's conditions BEFORE `dedupResShredByElement`, where the stat dedupe for buffs runs first (§1.H).

↻ And the trigger is `abilityType: ['skill', 'burst']` — gcsim attaches makeA4CB to the skill's initial hit, the Surging Blade, every Frosty Parfait AND the burst hit (burst.go:40,47). ⚠️ The array qualifies in BOTH cast pools, so an E-then-Q rotation emits a 12s window at each; the 2026-08-18 note left "do the two land on ONE row key?" as its verification boundary, and it is now MEASURED — `Escoffier E Q` draws ONE row and one merged span, because `mergeRefreshedBars` fuses same-shape overlaps. Non-overlapping casts stay two bars, which is correct.
↻ The caveat is RETIRED with them: both of its sentences — "assumes 4 Hydro or Cryo party members" and "in game it also applies on burst hits" — describe divergences that no longer exist.

⚓ NATE 2026-09-16, checked on screen: THE TWO-ROW SPLIT STAYS. `abilityType: ['skill','burst']` qualifies in both cast pools, so an `E Q` rotation draws `escoffier::char::E::resShred` and `escoffier::char::Q::resShred` as separate rows — each naming the cast that applied it, which is the lane's own grammar. ⛔ Don't 'fix' it back to a single `'skill'` trigger to collapse the rows: that is an under-claim (a Q-only or post-Mek Q draws no shred at all) patched by a caveat, and this was the open question the 2026-08-18 note left as its verification boundary. Closed.
passives.description: When there are 1/2/3/4 Hydro or Cryo characters in the party, Escoffier will decrease the Hydro RES and Cryo RES of any opponents hit by her Elemental Skill, Low-Temperature Cooking, or her Elemental Burst, Scoring Cuts, by 5%/10%/15%/55% for 12s.

constellations.name: Pre-Dinner Dance for Your Taste Buds
_curatorNotes: C1 adds AttackMod with CD=0.60 to every party char, filtered at apply-time on AttackTag and Element=Cryo (gcsim cons.go c1). Authored as the element-specific cryoCritDmg stat (added to the Stat union 2026-05-09).

Trigger fires on either skill or burst cast (gcsim c1() is called from both); ability field omitted intentionally per the Kazuha-C6 convention to fire on both. Lint will warn 'trigger-ability-missing' which is acceptable.

Conditions: constellation 1 AND teamElementCount(hydro+cryo) >= 3, authored 2026-07-20 (A7 wave 8). teamElementCount excludes the holder — Escoffier is Cryo, so 3 qualifying teammates = the kit's '4 party members all Hydro or Cryo' (matches gcsim c1Init, which walks every party char incl. Escoffier). The gate resolves definitively at planner time, so the buff renders only for qualifying 4-member teams.

[A7] C1 also gates on the A4 passive being unlocked (gcsim c1Init checks Ascension >= 4); not authored as a condition because the planner assumes ascension 4 by default (DEFAULT_ASCENSION), so the gate is satisfied in every default render. The former caveat about the optimistic team-comp render was deleted 2026-07-20 (A7 wave 8): with the teamElementCount gate evaluated by the planner, nothing un-modeled remains.
constellations.description:
When 4 party members are Hydro or Cryo, all nearby party members will have their Cryo DMG CRIT DMG increased by 60% for 15s after Escoffier uses her Elemental Skill Low-Temperature Cooking or Elemental Burst Scoring Cuts.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning."

constellations.name: Fresh, Fragrant Stew Is an Art
constellations.caveat: Per-hit stack consumption isn't modeled — add `{coldDish:N}` before E to set the stacks (up to 5). Only the Normal-attack DMG bonus is shown; in game the stacks also boost charged, plunge, skill, and burst DMG.
_curatorNotes: C2 mechanics: c2() called from skill() — sets c2Count = 5 and adds c2Key status for 15s. c2Init subscribes OnEnemyHit globally, filters: not Escoffier, active char, status active, c2Count > 0, element Cryo, AttackTag in {normal, charged, plunge, skill, burst}. On match: FlatDmg += c2Per × ATK = 240% × ATK; c2Count--.

Migrated to perStack-scaling BuffValue (2026-05-08): per: { stat: atk, ratio: 240 }, maxStacks: 5. Conditions gate visibility on (constellation 2) AND (stacks coldDish min 1). User asserts {coldDish:N} before E to set initial stacks; the bar resolves to ~N×240% ATK FlatDmg.

Authored only on normalFlatDmg to keep the team-buff row legible. Other stats (charge/plunge/skill/burstFlatDmg) would each render as a separate bar — verbose for a constellation effect. If team builder/comparison surfaces a need to model all 5, replicate the effect.

target: active is the closest schema fit. In practice Escoffier swaps off after E, so the active char (DPS) gets the buff correctly. If Escoffier camps on-field after E, she'd erroneously appear as the buff target — small edge case.

[A7] Per-stack value is 240% of ATK (renders in the buff bar). Stacks are granted on E cast (max 5) and consumed on the active character's Cryo hit; per-hit consumption is not modeled, hence the manual {coldDish:N} assertion.

↻ 2026-08-18 — THE CONCLUSION ABOVE STILL HOLDS, THE OLD REASON FOR IT DOES NOT. That line used to justify the manual assertion with "consumeStacks fires on cast only". False since the buff-bar/hit round: there are TWO dispatchers, `dispatchConsumeStacksOnCast` (src/lib/sim/stacks.ts:157) and `dispatchConsumeStacksOnHit` (:516, gate at :531, called from run.ts:346), and the onHit one already carries what this C2 needs — `onHitTriggerMatches` honours `source: 'others'` ("apart from Escoffier") and `trigger.filter.element: 'cryo'`, and the shape is lint-legal (characterLint.ts:2367-2374 permits onCast and onHit; only onReaction is refused). The real reason the manual assertion is still needed is simply that NO `gainStacks`/`consumeStacks` pair is authored for `coldDish` — grep this file: the key appears only in the buff's `stacks` condition and its `perStack` value.

⚠️ AND AUTHORING THE PAIR WOULD NOT MAKE THE BAR COUNT DOWN — check this before deciding it is worth doing. This effect's trigger is `onCast ability:'skill'`, and a cast-anchored window is emitted once with `cast.stackContext`, the snapshot taken AT the cast (buffWindows.ts:474/493; snapshot convention at stacks.ts:149-151, run.ts:597). So the bar would resolve to 5 × 240% ATK for its whole 15s span regardless of later consumption. Only the per-HIT emit path re-reads stacks per window (`stackContext: hit.stacks`, buffWindows.ts:694-704), and this buff does not use it. Authoring the pair WOULD, however, retire the `{coldDish:N}` assertion from the user's notation and make the stacks-min-1 gate real.

[A7] Only the Normal-attack flat-DMG stat is authored (canonical case — most teams ride the buff with normals or burst); in game it applies to all five ability-class flat-DMG stats gated on Cryo damage. The Cryo-only filter and the active-char-only filter (the caster's own hits don't consume stacks) are not enforced.
constellations.description:
When Escoffier activates her Cooking Mek in its Cold Storage Mode, she will gain the "Freshly-Prepped Delicacy" effect for 15s. During this time, Escoffier will gain 5 Cold Dish stacks. When nearby active characters apart from Escoffier deal Cryo DMG with a Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attack, or an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they will expend 1 Cold Dish stack to increase their DMG dealt by 240% of Escoffier's ATK.
If you hit multiple opponents with a single instance of Cryo DMG, Cold Dish stacks will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit.

constellations.name: The Bakery Magic of Caramel Browning
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Low-Temperature Cooking by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Secret Rosemary Recipe
_curatorNotes: Two effects, neither authored: (a) Rehab Diet duration extended +6s — gcsim c4ExtraCount() returns 6 extra heal ticks on top of the base 9. Schema lacks 'extend passive heal effect duration' modifier. (b) During Rehab Diet, on heal trigger: chance based on Escoffier's CR to heal +100% HP and restore 2 energy. Pure CR-based RNG; planner doesn't track Escoffier's stats. Max 7 procs per Rehab Diet (c4Limit). Skipped — flag.
constellations.description:
Rehab Diet lasts 6 more seconds. While it is active, you have a chance of healing 100% extra HP and restoring 2 Energy to Escoffier when you trigger healing through Rehab Diet. This chance corresponds to Escoffier's CRIT Rate. You can trigger this effect 7 times during any one Rehab Diet's duration.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Better to Salivate Than Medicate."

constellations.name: Symphony of a Thousand Sauces
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Scoring Cuts by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Tea Parties Bursting With Color
_curatorNotes: C6 mechanics: c6Init subscribes OnEnemyHit, filters: active char's NA/CA/PL only, skillKey active (Cooking Mek), c6Count > 0, c6ICDKey not active. On match: 0.5s ICD applied; QueueAttack with mult=5 (500% ATK Cryo, AttackTag ElementalArt); c6Count--.

AUTHORED with the onHit wiring (2026-07-17): damage effect, trigger onHit abilityType [normal,charged,plunge] (array = ONE shared 0.5s procCooldown clock across all three classes) source 'others' (teammate hits only — Escoffier's own attacks excluded, matching gcsim's active-char filter since she is off-field while the active char attacks). The duringSummon state condition resolves against ESCOFFIER's windows at hit time via the parser's holderStatesAt (its summon-activity check covers following summons — the Cooking Mek). Dispatch is gate-verified in parser tests; damage effects still have NO timeline render surface, so nothing draws yet.

NOT modeled: the 6-proc-per-Mek cap (c6Limit — would need a maxProcs field; deferred until a render surface exists) and Elemental Skill DMG ICD-group sharing. The 0.5s ICD collapses multi-hit swings to ~one proc, so per-swing hit granularity is near-exact here.
constellations.description:
Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode is enhanced:
· When your party's active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode will fire off another Special-Grade Frosty Parfait, dealing 500% of Escoffier's ATK as AoE Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, and this effect can be triggered 6 times within the duration of one Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode.
